guideTitle: The Best Non-Slip Desk Pads That Stay Where You Put Them
metaDescription: A desk pad that slides is worse than none. We compared eight low-cost PU leather pads on non-slip backing, size and material, and flag which listings explain their grip.
introParagraphs: A desk pad that creeps as you type or move the mouse quickly becomes an annoyance. Grip comes from the underside: a textured or suede-like backing, or a dense rubbery material, holds better than a smooth plastic back.

Most listings here say "non-slip" without describing the backing, so the AFIING, which lists a dedicated non-slip backing, stands out. Desk finish matters too: very glossy or glass desks are harder for any pad to grip.
All eight are PU leather pads under $15 at the time of writing, and several are variants of the same Aothia and YSAGi products. Our comparison is based on listed specifications, not hands-on testing.

best-non-slip-desk-pads-1.summary: Aothia's 23.6 x 13.7-inch waterproof PU leather protector with non-slip design.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-1.description:
The Aothia is a simple, clearly sized protector: 23.6 x 13.7 inches of waterproof PU leather, described as guarding against scratches, stains, spills, heat and scuffs, with a non-slip design.

That size suits a laptop or compact keyboard and mouse rather than a full desk.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-1.skipIf: You need more coverage; the QiyI is 31.5 x 15.7 inches.

best-non-slip-desk-pads-2.summary: A YSAGi PU leather protector; confirm size on the listing.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-2.description:
The YSAGi Leather Office Desk Pad Protector is a PU leather pad YSAGi says protects against scratches, stains, spills, heat and scuffs.

The listing summary doesn't state size. YSAGi has three listings here with the same description, so compare sizes and colors across them.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-2.bestFor: A basic leather protector once size is confirmed.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-2.skipIf: You want a stated size; the Aothia lists 23.6 x 13.7 inches.

best-non-slip-desk-pads-3.summary: A black 23.6 x 13.7-inch PU leather protector with non-slip design, the cheapest here.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-3.description:
This unbranded protector matches the Aothia's 23.6 x 13.7-inch size in black PU leather with a non-slip design, at about $7 at the time of writing, the lowest price here.

The brand isn't named in the listing.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-3.skipIf: You prefer a named brand; the Aothia is the same size.

best-non-slip-desk-pads-5.summary: A third YSAGi PU leather protector listing.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-5.description:
The third YSAGi listing uses the same description at about $10 at the time of writing.

As with the others, check the size and color it covers before buying.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-5.skipIf: You need a stated size; the Aothia or unbranded pad lists one.

best-non-slip-desk-pads-6.summary: Another YSAGi PU leather listing with the same description, at a higher price.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-6.description:
This YSAGi listing shares the same description as the other two and cost about $4 more at the time of writing, which likely reflects a larger size or different color.

Confirm what the extra cost buys on the listing.
cons: Costs more than other YSAGi listings
best-non-slip-desk-pads-6.bestFor: A specific YSAGi size or color.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-6.skipIf: A cheaper YSAGi listing has the size you need.

best-non-slip-desk-pads-7.summary: Aothia's PU leather protector in a 15.7-inch-deep size for laptop, keyboard and mouse.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-7.description:
This Aothia listing is a larger version, 15.7 inches deep, which Aothia says fits a laptop, mouse and keyboard.

The full width isn't given in the listing summary; it cost about $4 more than the compact Aothia at the time of writing.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-7.skipIf: Your space is compact; the 23.6-inch Aothia costs less.

best-non-slip-desk-pads-4.summary: AFIING's 23.6 x 13.7-inch waterproof PU leather pad with a dedicated non-slip backing.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-4.description:
The AFIING lists a dedicated non-slip backing, the feature this guide is about, on a 23.6 x 13.7-inch waterproof PU leather pad with a smooth surface, for under $9 at the time of writing.

It's compact, suited to a laptop or compact keyboard and mouse.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-4.bestFor: A compact pad that needs to stay put.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-4.skipIf: You need a larger pad; the QiyI is 31.5 x 15.7 inches.

best-non-slip-desk-pads-8.summary: An 80 x 40 cm PU leather pad in many colors, with dense non-slip PU material.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-8.description:
The QiyI is the largest pad here, 31.5 x 15.7 inches, in water-resistant PU leather that QiyI describes as dense and non-slip, with many colors and patterns.

It covers a keyboard, mouse and laptop together. The listing doesn't describe a separate backing layer.
best-non-slip-desk-pads-8.skipIf: You want a dedicated grip backing; the AFIING lists one.

buyingCriteria.explanation: Listings that describe a non-slip backing (AFIING) tell you more than a bare "non-slip" claim.
Glass and glossy lacquer are harder to grip; wood and laminate are easier.
Pads here are 23.6 x 13.7 inches or 31.5 x 15.7 inches, or unstated; measure first.
Larger, heavier pads tend to shift less than small, light ones.

faq.q: Why does my desk pad slide?
faq.a: A smooth backing on a smooth desk has little friction. A textured or suede-like backing, or a heavier pad, helps.

faq.q: Do non-slip pads work on glass?
faq.a: Glass is harder to grip. Look for a pad with a described grip backing and check the listing for glass-desk guidance.
Measure your keyboard and mouse side by side and allow a margin.
They share a description and likely differ in size or color; buy whichever fits for the least.

faq.q: Does a bigger pad slide less?
faq.a: A larger pad has more contact area and weight, which tends to help.

bottomLine: For grip, the AFIING is the pad that describes a dedicated non-slip backing, at a low price. For more coverage, the QiyI is the full-size option.
The Aothia, YSAGi and unbranded pads are low-cost alternatives, but their listings say less about how they grip; confirm size before buying.
